product_one_liner.value: Plannerly is a cloud-based BIM management platform that helps architecture, engineering, and construction professionals plan, manage, and verify BIM projects.
product_one_liner.notes: The help article directly describes the product and its AEC audience.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists Free, Pro, and Company plans and pricing details.

named_customers.notes: The customers page includes testimonials from a BNBuilders BIM Manager and an Amazon BIM Manager.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 17 employees, and Prospeo gives the matching 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: The company profile lists Irvine, California, United States as its locality.

founded_year.notes: The company profile lists Plannerly as founded in 2017.

eng_blog.notes: The index is a BIM/ISO management guide and product-education blog, with case studies and launch/partner content rather than engineering posts explaining how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Plannerly has a public Help Center and an integrations collection containing multiple help articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No live, verifiable careers listing or job board with current openings was found; the /careers URL resolves to product-marketing content rather than a job listing.

model_provider.notes: Plannerly lists OpenAI as a service provider for AI features.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust page attributes ISO 27001 and SOC 2 to infrastructure providers and says Plannerly is preparing for its own certification; it does not claim any of the listed certifications for Plannerly itself.

last_funding.notes: A funding profile reports a $4.12 million Series A on April 30, 2025; Caplight instead lists an Accelerator round in 2019 as its most recent, so the public funding chronology conflicts and this is the best-supported newer report, not a fully corroborated record.

raised_18mo.notes: The newer reported round closed April 30, 2025, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025; the other identified round is earlier still.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No live, verifiable careers listing or job board with current openings was found, so SDR/BDR/account-executive hiring cannot be established.

launched_6mo.notes: Plannerly announced its biggest update, with 50+ improvements, on August 28, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small leadership roster identifies current executives and available profiles show some in Plannerly roles since 2017, but I could not verify a start date for every current VP or confirm a departure; the 12-month change result is therefore unknown.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable integrations documentation names BIM and AI connections but no CRM or sales/marketing platform.
